{{Quote|The Jenet my servant Lotkha brought me is actually quite useful. I've taken to calling him Jen, which he's come to tolerate without argument.|Bwahl|<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Bwahl the Hutt SWAJ14.png|thumb|right|200px|Lotkha served Bwahl the Hutt (pictured).]]
'''Lotkha''' was an individual who served [[Bwahl]],<ref name="EGAS" /> a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] trader.<ref name="CSWE Bwahl">{{CSWECite|I|98|Bwahl}}</ref> Lotkha provided a member of the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to Bwahl, later named "[[Jen (Jenet)|Jen]]" by the Hutt. The Jenet proved useful to Hutt, and he recorded Jen in a description that mentioned Lotkha. Bwahl's words were used in the Jenet section of ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', a [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] centered around various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species using media collected by [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]]. It was published with the help of a [[Ann Margaret Lewis|professional writer]] no earlier than [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="EGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lotkha was introduced in [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], a [[2001]] reference book written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]].<ref name="EGAS" />
